semantics.resolution_rule: Remote marker resolves a declared external/remote target through DWH remote semantics.
semantics.ext_rule: EXT may provide target registration metadata but is not the governed data dereference itself when AC is active.
semantics.local_rule: Local and remote addresses remain distinguishable in canonical parsing.
semantics.authority_rule: Remote address resolution does not itself authorize read/write.
semantics.target_rule: Resolved target evaluates its own applicable DWH/AccessCore policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown/ambiguous remote target hard-fails rather than falling back local.
semantics.trace_rule: Resolution records original address, external target identity and resolved remote resource.

invariants.rule: DWH applies data-boundary policy at the origin and target independently; remote addressing, transport reachability and external registration never substitute for AccessCore authorization.

hard_gates.condition: remote address falls back to local silently
AC-active remote path dereferences raw EXT directly
